name: @ham2k/lib-vhf-contests
description: What the IARU R1 and RSGB VHF+ contest extensions share: the REG1TEST/EDI writer, the grid exchange, the ref readers and the band multipliers
author: Sebastian Delmont <sd@ham2k.com>
//exports: Consumed as TypeScript source: the only consumers are extensions, which
esbuild bundles, so there is no build step and no dist/ to point at.
//dependencies: The writer formats its own timestamps through the host's copy of
lib-format-tools, which the consuming extension declares in its manifest
and the build rewrites to a host lookup.
//peerDependencies: The SDK is provided by the extension that consumes this package: its own
bundle carries one copy, rewritten to the host's instance at build time.
